title: Juniper and the Summit
author: Lior Almeida
blurb: Yara Iversen, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
